title: Nutritious Kenyan Lentils Skewers
description: A savory and energizing Kenyan dish featuring lentils, dry sherry, and render fat, perfect for a snack or light meal. This shojin-friendly recipe is crisp and full of flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the dry sherry, render fat, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped onion, minced garlic, and grated ginger to the bowl and stir to combine.
Add the rinsed and drained red lentils to the bowl and stir until they are evenly coated with the marinade.
Thread the marinated lentils onto skewers, leaving a small space between each lentil.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes.
Serve the lentil skewers hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
